root_cause: Cancel returned after a queued CAS even when the job had started, repeatedly cancelled an already cancelling owner task, cancelled terminal job finalizers and swallowed cancellation of its own waiter as if only the child had been cancelled.
changes: Inspect queued cancellation result and fall through to the running owner when the job won the start race
Return terminal job state without interrupting its still-owned finalizer
Send cancellation only when the owner has no outstanding cancellation request; otherwise join the same cleanup
Propagate cancellation of the waiting caller while preserving the shielded owned job task
Keep agent scope checks and retain running truth when no actual owner can be found
